method: Reproduced R2-FINAL-01: the old instrument printed 11/11 and 100% while 46 reviewer findings remained OPEN because it deliberately ignored review artifacts.
Separated the four questions the old percentage conflated: contract shape, independent review, seal readiness, and product implementation/release qualification.
Made final-review and surface-review artifacts explicit register inputs and treated every finding ID as OPEN until a registered adjudication resolves or rejects it.
Added discovery of unregistered reviews that name current binding artifacts and a self-test proving that green prose cannot overwrite an OPEN state.

findingDispositions.evidence: Before repair, all seven Reviewer 2 artifacts carried OPEN resolves maps while check-completeness.py reported all eleven surfaces clean and 100%.
findingDispositions.reasoning: Contract-shape presence, independent review, adjudicated seal readiness, and product release evidence are different predicates. A single percentage invited the exact paper seal the exercise forbids.
findingDispositions.requiredChange: Register current reviews/adjudications, ingest their finding IDs fail-closed, expose unregistered applicable reviews, derive surface seal readiness, and report release qualification separately.
findingDispositions.verification: The repaired instrument reports 11/11 shape separately, lists every unadjudicated open ID, reports cross-cutting R2-FINAL-02/03 open, and reports product qualification as 0/25. Its self-test rejects an OPEN finding even when prose says the checker passes.
findingDispositions.whatWouldChangeMyMind: An alternative mechanically synchronized ingestion path from reviews to claim-register sealBlockers with equivalent fail-closed behavior.

sealedPropertiesCovered: current independent reviews are registered and consumed
seal readiness requires final finding dispositions and no blocker
product release qualification requires demonstrated product evidence
knownLimitations: The instrument validates declared architecture evidence and review state; it cannot itself determine whether a reviewer's reasoning is substantively correct.
R2-FINAL-02 and R2-FINAL-03 are outside Agent B's assigned cross-cutting finding and remain OPEN for coordinator adjudication.
A product can become release-qualified only through the operability release-evidence path, not by editing this instrument.

sealRecommendation.note: The measurement instrument is now fail-closed over registered review findings. The architecture set is not thereby sealable.
sealRecommendation.consumerB: Use the four separate outputs; never interpret 11/11 contract shape as reviewed, seal-ready, or released.
